acceptedAnswer.text: The real estate market in Palm Beach can be dynamic, influenced by seasonality, economic conditions, and demand for luxury properties. Inventory levels, median home prices, and time on the market can fluctuate. Understanding current trends is crucial for both buyers and sellers. As your real estate agent, Kelby Contreras tracks these changes across Palm Beach County, including specific areas like Palm Beach and West Palm Beach, to provide up-to-date insights and help you make informed decisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: The Palm Beach real estate market is dynamic, influenced by seasonality and demand. Inventory levels and prices can fluctuate, so understanding current trends is key.
